What could competitive games learn from cooperative games?

For me the best feeling in co-op is blazing through a horde of enemies with your team like a well-oiled machine. This is something you can get in team vs team games on a good day, but co-op has always done very well. I think that competitive games could incorporate that feeling of "you are many, but I am mighty" that you get in a typical co-op game, but I don't see it done very often.

A good example of this concept is Titanfall, which has a competitive team-based mode where a handful of player characters are placed on each team along with a swarm of friendly and hostile AI. The effect is that you feel like a particularly skilled solder who only has to worry about the other skilled player soldiers while you cut down hordes of less skilled AI.
